title: Boy Running in Park, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo, Utica NY
back_text_transcription: Connie & Gary - Utica State Park - Picnic June 5, 1955
description: A black and white 1955 snapshot capturing a young boy named Gary running joyfully toward the camera across a grassy park lawn. In the background, a woman (Connie) walks near a vintage metal playground slide and other parkgoers enjoying a summer picnic outing. The side margin includes a photofinisher stamp reading JUL 55.
